kappa.label: kappa
kappa.description: Odd nilpotent symbol of the inhomogeneous deformation; first in PBW order. Not a basis element of C(n+1).

K.label: K
K.description: Even central identity of the pre-oscillator extension A = V + CK + C kappa. Identified with the scalar 1; excluded from the basis and from PBW ordering.

odd_linear_map.description: General odd linear map f: g -> g~ = g (+) C K, f(Z_j) = sum_i phi_{ij} Z_i with p(Z_i) = p(Z_j) + 1. K (even, central) is an allowed target for odd Z_j; f(K) = 0 is implicit (f is defined on g).

coboundary.description: Coboundary (delta f)(X,Y) = (-1)^{p(X)} [X,f(Y)] - (-1)^{(p(X)+1)p(Y)} [Y,f(X)] - f([X,Y]); entries give the Z-component as a linear form in the phi parameters.
coboundary.pair_convention: All ordered pairs (X, Y) with non-zero (delta f)(X, Y) are listed.
coboundary.triviality_criterion: gamma (Schema 2/3) is trivial iff gamma = delta f for some phi (equivalently gamma = -delta f, replacing f by -f).
